crossRefs.note: Only you shall not eat the blood. You shall pour it out on the earth like water.
Only be sure that you don’t eat the blood; for the blood is the life. You shall not eat the life with the meat.
You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

translations.web: Only you shall not eat its blood. You shall pour it out on the ground like water.
translations.bsb: But you must not eat the blood; pour it on the ground like water.
translations.kjv: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.
translations.asv: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it out upon the ground as water.
